notes.title: Trading Cards and WOLF badges are active now!
notes.content:
Shoppa and game community were asking..
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/259640/discussions/1/558750624741772726/]Where is the Trading Cards?[/url]

While it is supposed to be available from day one of the release, a technical problem prevented the dropping of the Trading Cards during playing the game.

Thanks to game community who raised this issue, we contacted Valve and worked together in order to get those cards and badges active and can be dropped during playing the game.

[u][b]As an apology:[/b][/u]
You can get the game and Save up to 60% off during this weekend.

[u][b]As a technical updates:[/b][/u]
- we patched the game with textures pack (1 of 3)
- VC audio is normalized

[u][b]Updates for the community:[/b][/u]
We decided to open workshops for this game and allow fans to work with us on the modelling, textures and animations, as well as making new levels for the game too.

Let's all make Guise Of The Wolf an awesome experience! Remember, it's the unique indie werewolf game in 2014 so far!

notes.title: Guise Of The Wolf: Latest Update
notes.content:
While we decided to improve the game based on your feedback, we wanted to upload this fix ASAP, the update will fix the following:

1) High Res feature added to work on: 1400x1050 / 1440x900 / 1600x900 resolutions.
2) Performance for: 1280x1024 / 1280x800 1280x720 resolutions.
3) Out of memory crash.
4) Audio bug of the werewolf.
5) Lighting for dark areas.
6) Fall crash at the library balcony.

Disadvantage:
1) old save files will not work properly.


New Game Version: 2


We shall update the game frequently as promised. Thank you for your support and encouragement!
